### 2026-10-14 – Started with the cad yesterday, and then continued today. i designed the ratchet, digit wheel, carrier gear, and the pawls. the ratchet mechanism confused me a bit so i had to take a break and do some

**3.22h**

Started with the cad yesterday, and then continued today. i designed the ratchet, digit wheel, carrier gear, and the pawls. the ratchet mechanism confused me a bit so i had to take a break and do some research. solidworks was acting up - very slow and even shut down a few times, but eventually it became better. i started with the assembly too, but didnt get very far.

### 2026-10-16 – thisi was by far the most crash out worthy cad session ive ever done. even solidworks crashed on me. i thought i was good at cad but today really humbled me. i spent the entire time on the carry mecha

**2.25h**

thisi was by far the most crash out worthy cad session ive ever done. even solidworks crashed on me. i thought i was good at cad but today really humbled me. i spent the entire time on the carry mechanism, specifically getting the carry pinion and the 2 teeth side of the digit wheel to mesh. for the better part of the session, i couldnt even get then to stop overlapping, and i even redid the gears with blocky teeth(dont know why i though that would help). eventually after studying the mechanism, i figured that the gear that i hought was split in 2 parts was actually 3 (4?) parts, and after editing the digit wheel and carrier pinion, it still didn work! finally i tried decreasing the outer diameter of the carrier, without touching the pitch diameter -- and this was the key to everything.  i feel so stupid after figuring it out.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/0c519223-7966-4eb0-9f99-2c1c882a3abb/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-17 – today i made alot of progress- finished up the mechanism completely, with as much testing as solidworks let me, and then i also made the case/enclosure. productive session overall- though i got a baji

**3.07h**

today i made alot of progress- finished up the mechanism completely, with as much testing as solidworks let me, and then i also made the case/enclosure. productive session overall- though i got a bajillion errors in the process. hopefully any changes i made dont mess with the mechanism ( it shouldnt, but since when do things what they should) i was going to check, but solidworks became super slow so i decided to call it a day.
i stupidly forgot to click resume for my lapse and the last 0.5 hr didnt get recorded, so i added that part separately.
all thats left now is some support structures, managing tolerances, final checks. and i also forgot to add accomodations for the springs, so ill do that too.

### 2026-10-18 – finally finished up the cad for my mechanical counter! i genuinly have no idea if its gonna work (it should in theory), because the animation/simulation was really terrible. i added tolerances to hope

**2.83h**

finally finished up the cad for my mechanical counter! i genuinly have no idea if its gonna work (it should in theory), because the animation/simulation was really terrible. i added tolerances to hopefully everything, and added mounts for springs - which i hope i can source easily. i tidied up the case, added the numbers, and made some changes to the mechanism. i have no time left for the week,so i relly hope i thought of everything.
